source: Statutory Dispute & Triage Guides (Motor Vehicles Act, Transfer of Property Act, Payment of Wages Act, Consumer Protection Act)
notes: TODO: Standardized scenario action trees. Requires advocate review before production release.

scenarios.title: Police Stopped Me On The Road
scenarios.subtitle: Traffic check, breathalyzer, and vehicle document verification

flow.question: Is the officer demanding original physical documents?
flow.guidance: Under MoRTH Notification RT-11036/64/2017-MVL, electronic documents stored on DigiLocker or mParivahan are legally valid and must be accepted by all police and transport officials across India.

flow.question: Are they conducting a breathalyzer / alcohol test?
flow.guidance: Under Section 203 of Motor Vehicles Act, police can administer a breath test. If you refuse without reasonable cause, you may be arrested under Section 203(3) and taken to a registered medical practitioner for a blood test.
options: Ensure breathalyzer mouthpiece is freshly unwrapped

flow.question: Is an officer asking for spot cash payment without an e-challan?
flow.guidance: Only officers of the rank of Sub-Inspector (SI) or above are authorized to compound traffic fines on the spot. Always insist on an official printed e-challan or digital SMS receipt.

scenarios.title: Landlord Won't Return Security Deposit
scenarios.subtitle: Unfair deductions, post-vacating delays, and recovery options

flow.question: Have you vacated and returned keys?
flow.guidance: Ensure you have written evidence (email/WhatsApp confirmation) of key handover and date of vacating. Without this, landlord may claim ongoing rent liability.
options: Keep photos of clean, empty premises

flow.question: Are deductions claimed for normal wear and tear?
flow.guidance: Under tenancy laws, painting and normal structural weathering due to age are the landlord's maintenance responsibility and cannot be deducted from the tenant's security deposit unless specifically clause-stipulated.

flow.question: Landlord refuses to refund after 30 days?
flow.guidance: Issue a formal Legal Notice through an advocate giving 15 days to refund with statutory interest. If unaddressed, approach the local Rent Authority or file a consumer/civil summary suit for recovery.
options: File before Rent Authority / Civil Court

scenarios.title: Salary Unpaid or Delayed by Employer
scenarios.subtitle: Wage recovery, full & final settlement, and labor commissioner remedy

flow.question: What is your employment categorization?
flow.guidance: Employees covered under the Payment of Wages Act, 1936 must be paid within 7 to 10 days of the wage period completion. For managerial/executive roles, the employment contract and Indian Contract Act apply.

flow.question: Has the company given written reasons for delay?
flow.guidance: Send a formal email to HR and Finance requesting salary disbursement. Verbal promises cannot be enforced without an email paper trail.
options: Send written demand email with 7-day deadline
Preserve work logs, attendance & email trail

flow.question: Employer still fails to pay Full & Final (F&F)?
flow.guidance: File a conciliation grievance with the Deputy Labour Commissioner (DLC). You can also send a Legal Notice under Section 33C of Industrial Disputes Act or Section 447 of Companies Act for fraud.

scenarios.title: Defective Product or Counterfeit Item
scenarios.subtitle: E-commerce returns, warranty refusal, and e-Daakhil filing

flow.question: Did you report the defect within the return window?
flow.guidance: Under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, platforms cannot impose unfair contract terms or refuse return of goods that differ from the description or have manufacturing defects.
options: Save tax invoice and order summary
Record unboxing video or photographs of defect

flow.question: Did seller or customer service reject refund?
flow.guidance: Lodge an official grievance on the National Consumer Helpline portal (consumerhelpline.gov.in) or call toll-free 1915. Most major e-commerce platforms resolve tickets within 7 days once escalated here.
options: Tag platform grievance officer with NCH docket number

flow.question: Product caused injury or heavy financial loss?
flow.guidance: Under Chapter VI of Consumer Protection Act 2019, file a Product Liability action against both manufacturer and seller before the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission via e-Daakhil (edaakhil.nic.in).
